When no video generation providers are configured, the agent generates still images and Remotion turns them into fully animated video. HyperFrames Local (Node.js ≥ 22) HTML/CSS/GSAP programmatic video — kinetic typography, product promos, launch reels, custom motion graphics, registry blocks (data charts, grain overlays, shader transitions), website-to-video workflows, and rigged SVG character animation. Consumed via npx hyperframes; no monorepo checkout needed. FFmpeg Local Core video assembly, encoding, subtitle burn, audio muxing, color grading Runtime is chosen at proposal (render_runtime) and locked through edit_decisions. Silent swaps between runtimes are a governance violation — see skills/core/hyperframes.md. Style System Style playbooks define the visual language for your productions: Playbook Best For Clean Professional Corporate, educational, SaaS Flat Motion Graphics Social media, TikTok, startups Minimalist Diagram Technical deep-dives, architecture Playbooks control typography, color palettes, motion styles, audio profiles, and quality rules. The agent reads the playbook and applies it consistently across all generated assets. Platform Output Profiles Built-in render profiles for every major platform: Profile Resolution Aspect Ratio YouTube Landscape 1920x1080 16:9 YouTube 4K 3840x2160 16:9 YouTube Shorts 1080x1920 9:16 Instagram Reels 1080x1920 9:16 Instagram Feed 1080x1080 1:1 TikTok 1080x1920 9:16 LinkedIn 1920x1080 16:9 Cinematic 2560x1080 21:9 Production Governance OpenMontage treats video production like real engineering — with quality gates, audit trails, and enforcement at every stage. Quality Gates Pre-compose validation — blocks render if the delivery promise is violated (e.g. "motion-led" video with 80% still images), slideshow risk score is critical, or renderer family is missing. Catches broken plans before wasting GPU time. Post-render self-review — after every render, the runtime runs ffprobe validation, extracts frames at 4 positions to check for black frames and broken overlays, analyzes audio levels for silence and clipping, verifies the delivery promise was honored, and checks subtitle presence. If the review fails, the video is not presented. Slideshow risk scoring — 6-dimension analysis (repetition, decorative visuals, weak motion, shot intent, typography overreliance, unsupported cinematic claims) prevents "animated PowerPoint" outputs. Source media inspection — when users supply their own footage, the system probes every file (resolution, codec, audio channels, duration) and builds planning implications before a single creative decision is made. No hallucinating content from filenames. Scored Provider Selection Every tool selection (video generation, image generation, TTS, music) runs through a 7-dimension scoring engine: task fit (30%), output quality (20%), control features (15%), reliability (15%), cost efficiency (10%), latency (5%), continuity (5%). The winning provider and its score are logged in the decision trail with all alternatives considered. Selectors normalize loose brief context before scoring. If the agent only knows something like "Pixar-style animated short with character consistency," the selector expands that into scorer-friendly intent and style signals instead of requiring a perfectly pre-shaped task_context. Selector outputs also surface the chosen provider's agent_skills, so the agent can immediately read the right Layer 3 provider skill before writing prompts. Decision Audit Trail Every major creative and technical choice — provider selection, style/playbook choice, music track, voice selection, renderer family, any fallback or downgrade — is logged with alternatives considered, confidence scores, and reasoning. The cumulative decision log persists across all stages so you can trace exactly why the output looks the way it does. Budget Controls Estimate before execution — see what it will cost Reserve budget — lock funds before the call Reconcile after — record actual spend Configurable modes — observe (track only), warn (log overruns), cap (hard limit) Per-action approval — pause for confirmation above a threshold (default: $0.50) Total budget cap — default $10, fully configurable No surprise bills. The agent tells you what it will cost before it spends. Agent Compatibility OpenMontage works with any AI coding assistant that can read files and execute Python. Dedicated instruction files are included for: Platform Config File Claude Code CLAUDE.md Cursor CURSOR.md + .cursor/rules/ GitHub Copilot COPILOT.md + .github/copilot-instructions.md Codex CODEX.md Windsurf .windsurfrules All platform files point to the shared AGENT_GUIDE.md (operating guide and agent contract) and PROJECT_CONTEXT.md (architecture reference). Coming soon: Local LLM support via Ollama and LM Studio — run the full production pipeline without any cloud LLM. Contributing OpenMontage is built to be extended. The two most common contributions: Adding a New Tool Create a Python file in the appropriate tools/ subdirectory Inherit from BaseTool and implement the tool contract The registry auto-discovers it — no manual registration needed Add a skill file if the tool needs usage guidance Adding a New Pipeline Create a YAML manifest in pipeline_defs/ Create stage director skills in skills/pipelines/<your-pipeline>/ Reference existing tools — or add new ones if needed See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the full technical reference, docs/PROVIDERS.md for the complete provider guide (setup, pricing, free tiers), and AGENT_GUIDE.md for the agent contract. Join the Community We use GitHub Discussions to share work and ideas: Show and Tell — Share videos you've made, prompts that worked well, or creative workflows you've discovered Ideas — Suggest new pipelines, tools, style playbooks, or integrations Q&A — Ask questions about setup, pipelines, or troubleshooting Made something cool? Post it in Show and Tell — we'd love to see what you build. Contact For updates, releases, and behind-the-scenes build notes, follow @calesthioailabs. For bugs, feature requests, and workflow discussions, use GitHub Issues and GitHub Discussions so everything stays visible and actionable. Testing # Run contract tests (no API keys needed) make test-contracts # Run all tests make test License GNU AGPLv3 OpenMontage — Production-grade video with real quality enforcement, orchestrated by your AI assistant. tldr: 首个开源智能体视频制作系统，通过AI编码助手用自然语言生成完整视频
objective_summary: calesthio 发布了 OpenMontage，首个开源的智能体视频制作系统。用户通过 Claude Code 等 AI 编码助手用自然语言描述需求，系统自动完成研究、脚本、素材生成、剪辑和渲染。提供 12 条流水线、52 个工具，示例成品成本低至 0.15 美元。
key_logic_flow: OpenMontage 是最早的开源智能体视频制作系统，提供 12 条制作流水线、52 个工具和 500 多项智能体技能。
用户通过 AI 编码助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等）用自然语言描述需求，系统自动完成研究、脚本、素材生成、剪辑和渲染全流程。
系统支持两种视频路径：基于图像的动画（用 FLUX 等生成图片后由 Remotion 动画化），以及真实素材视频（从 Archive.org、Pexels 等检索真实视频片段剪辑合成）。
提供 Remotion（React 渲染）和 HyperFrames（HTML/GSAP 渲染）两种合成引擎，根据项目需求自动选择。
支持从参考视频（YouTube、Reel、TikTok）出发进行分析并生成差异化方案，包括风格、节奏、成本估算等。
视频制作成本极低，展示示例从 0.15 美元（纯图片动画）到 1.33 美元（60秒动画短片）不等。

impact_score.reason: OpenMontage 是首个开源的智能体视频制作系统，核心价值在于将视频制作成本从传统数千美元骤降至 0.15–1.33 美元级别，并提供 12 条流水线、52 个工具和 500+ 智能体技能的完整系统架构。这不是 ChatGPT 级别的范式转移（8–10 分），但显著高于日常更新（1–3 分）：它直接改变了视频创作的成本结构和准入壁垒，对内容创作者、营销团队和独立开发者有实质性赋能效应，属于'改变局部竞争格局'的重要产品发布。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: AI 编码助手驱动的视频全流程自动化，以及 0.15 美元级极低制作成本的可行性

hype_assessment.reason: 文中'first open-source agentic video production system'的首创性声明需要独立验证（存在同类竞品的可能性），且'video video'与'stills animation'的区分带有 PR 防御色彩。但成本数字（$0.15–$1.33）具体可查，技术架构描述详实（12 pipelines、52 tools、双合成引擎、7 维度供应商评分）。整体属于有干货的合理包装，未达到严重概念炒作级别。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 提出了一套完整的智能体视频制作系统架构：以 AI 编码助手为主控协调层，集成 Remotion（React 渲染）和 HyperFrames（HTML/GSAP 渲染）双合成引擎，通过 52 个工具编排实现从研究、脚本、素材生成（FLUX/Piper TTS/WhisperX）、剪辑到渲染的全流程自动化。核心创新点在于 7 维度供应商评分系统和多阶段自我审查机制（ffprobe 验证、帧采样、音频电平分析），使得 AI 编排的决策过程可审计、可追溯。
domain_disruption.business_model: 将传统视频制作所需数天团队协作、数千美元成本压缩到单人、数分钟、低于 2 美元的全自动流程，直接冲击传统视频制作公司、素材平台（Getty Images/Envato）和 freelance 市场的商业模式。同时大幅降低了专业视频制作的技术和资金门槛，为个人创作者、教育工作者和中小企业开辟了 AI 原生视频制作的可行路径。

compound_value.reason: OpenMontage 开创了'开源智能体视频制作'这一新范式，以极低成本（$0.15起步）将自然语言到完整视频的全流程标准化。其长期复利价值在于：（1）先发优势——首个开源实现，定义流水线架构和工具注册表标准（12条流水线、52个工具、500+技能），有望成为社区事实标准；（2）模块化设计可随底层模型（FLUX、Veo、Remotion等）迭代持续升级，不受单一模型绑定；（3）参考视频分析+成本预估能力形成差异化壁垒，不仅仅是 prompt 编排。但主要风险是：底层原生视频生成大模型（Sora、Veo 2、Runway Gen-4）的快速进步可能逐步侵蚀多步骤编排的必要性，且开源许可证下 calesthio 自身价值捕获有限。整体有潜力成为 AI 视频制作领域的'FFmpeg级'基础设施，但需持续验证相对于端到端视频生成的差异化护城河。

key_beneficiaries: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf)
competitive_casualty: Adobe Premiere Pro / Final Cut Pro (低中端场景)
Shutterstock / Getty Images (素材搜索替代)
market_opportunities: 内容创作者可利用 OpenMontage 将视频制作成本从数千美元降至 1 美元以内，开辟超低成本短视频和社交媒体广告的蓝海市场
开发者可基于 OpenMontage 的 12 条流水线和 52 个工具框架，为垂直行业（如教育课件、电商产品展示、企业内部培训）定制专属智能体视频制作方案
参考视频逆向分析功能（从 YouTube/Reel/TikTok 生成差异化方案）蕴藏竞品内容分析和爆款复刻工具的商业化机会

risk_matrix.regulatory: AI 生成视频面临全球趋严的深度伪造（Deepfake）标识法规，如欧盟 AI Act 要求合成内容水印和透明披露，美国各州也在推进类似立法；使用参考视频分析可能触及原始创作者的版权衍生作品争议
risk_matrix.technological: 严重依赖第三方 API（FLUX、Veo、OpenAI、Chirp3 等），任一 API 策略变更或停服将直接影响系统能力；Remotion 和 HyperFrames 两种引擎的渲染质量与专业剪辑软件仍有差距
risk_matrix.competitive: OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen-3、Pika 等闭源视频生成模型在画质和多模态理解上持续进化，可能挤压智能体编排方案的市场空间；Meta、Google 若推出同类开源方案将带来生态挤压
risk_matrix.ethical: AI 自动生成的视频内容可能被大规模用于虚假信息传播和舆论操纵；超低成本（0.15 美元/条）大幅降低深度伪造门槛；对初级视频剪辑师、动画师等岗位构成就业替代冲击
additional: 项目尚处于早期阶段，社区生态未成熟，长期维护和兼容性存在不确定性

title: heygen-com/hyperframes
description:
Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents. Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents. Quickstart | Showcase | Playground | Catalog | Docs | Discord HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows. Quick Start With an AI coding agent Install the HyperFrames skills, then describe the video you want: npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes Try a prompt like: Using /hyperframes, create a 10-second product intro with a fade-in title, a background video, and subtle background music. The skills teach agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render. They work with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other coding agents that support skills. For visual design handoff workflows, see the Claude Design guide and Open Design guide. Manually with the CLI npx hyperframes init my-video cd my-video npx hyperframes preview # preview in browser with live reload npx hyperframes render # render to MP4 Requirements: Node.js 22+, FFmpeg What You Can Build Need ideas? Browse the Showcase for finished videos you can watch, read, run, and remix. Product launch videos and feature announcements PR walkthroughs with animated code diffs, narration, and captions Data visualizations, chart races, and map animations Social videos with kinetic captions, overlays, and music Docs-to-video, PDF-to-video, and website-to-video explainers Reusable motion graphics for automated content pipelines Frame.md frame.md — your design system, ready for video. Every brand has a design.md. None of them were written for a camera. frame.md is the missing translation layer: it takes your web-context design spec and inverts it for the frame — the same tokens, the same rules, but rewritten so an AI agent can compose a promo video without guessing at scale or reaching for web chrome. The output is a DESIGN.md superset your whole toolchain can read. Atoms stay sacred. Composition stays free. Numbers come from the script. Biennale Yellow BlockFrame Blue Professional Bold Poster Broadside Capsule Cartesian Cobalt Grid Coral Creative Mode Browse and remix them all at hyperframes.dev/design. How It Works Define a video as HTML. Add data attributes for timing and tracks. Use GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or your own frame adapter for seekable animation.

Launch day

Preview instantly in the browser. Render locally or in Docker. The renderer seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes the result with FFmpeg, so the same input produces the same video. HyperFrames Stack HyperFrames is the open-source rendering engine, plus a growing set of tools around HTML-native video creation. Piece Status What it does CLI Available Scaffold, preview, lint, inspect, and render local video projects Core / Engine / Producer Available Parse compositions, drive headless Chrome, encode video, and mix audio Catalog Available Reusable blocks and components for transitions, overlays, captions, charts, maps, and effects Agent skills Available Teach coding agents the video-production patterns that generic web docs miss Studio Available, evolving Browser surface for previewing and editing compositions AWS Lambda rendering Available Deploy a distributed render stack and drive renders from your laptop or CI hyperframes.dev Available Community playground for previewing, iterating, sharing, and rendering HTML-native video projects frame.md Available Invert your design system for the camera — a DESIGN.md superset an agent can compose video from Catalog Install ready-to-use blocks and components: npx hyperframes add flash-through-white # shader transition npx hyperframes add instagram-follow # social overlay npx hyperframes add data-chart # animated chart Browse the catalog at hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog. Why HyperFrames? HTML-native: compositions are HTML files with data attributes. No React requirement, no proprietary timeline format. Agent-friendly: agents already write HTML, and the CLI is non-interactive by default. Deterministic: same input, same frames, same output. Built for CI, regression tests, and automated rendering. No build step: an index.html composition plays as-is and can be previewed directly in the browser. Adapter-based animation: bring GSAP, CSS animations, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI, or a custom runtime. Open source: Apache 2.0 license, with no per-render fees or commercial-use thresholds. HyperFrames vs Remotion HyperFrames is inspired by Remotion. Both tools render video with headless Chrome and FFmpeg. The main difference is the authoring model: Remotion's bet is React components; HyperFrames' bet is plain HTML that humans and agents can both write easily. HyperFrames Remotion Authoring HTML + CSS + seekable animation React components Build step None; index.html plays as-is Bundler required Agent handoff Plain HTML files JSX / React project Library-clock animations Seekable, frame-accurate via adapters Wall-clock animation patterns need care Distributed rendering Local and AWS Lambda render paths Remotion Lambda, mature cloud renderer License Apache 2.0 Source-available Remotion License Read the full comparison in the HyperFrames vs Remotion guide. Documentation Full documentation: hyperframes.heygen.com/introduction Quickstart Showcase Guides API Reference Catalog Examples AWS Lambda rendering Packages Package Description hyperframes CLI for creating, previewing, linting, and rendering compositions @hyperframes/core Types, parsers, generators, linter, runtime, and frame adapters @hyperframes/engine Seekable page-to-video capture engine using Puppeteer and FFmpeg @hyperframes/producer Full rendering pipeline for capture, encode, and audio mix @hyperframes/studio Browser-based composition editor UI @hyperframes/player Embeddable web component @hyperframes/shader-transitions WebGL shader transitions for compositions @hyperframes/aws-lambda AWS Lambda SDK and deployment surface for distributed renders Community HyperFrames is used in production at HeyGen, with community examples from teams like tldraw, TanStack, and others in ADOPTERS.md. Open a PR if your team is using HyperFrames. Questions and ideas: Discord Bugs and feature requests: GitHub Issues Security reports: SECURITY.md Contributions: CONTRIBUTING.md Development Note The repo uses Git LFS for golden regression-test baselines under packages/producer/tests/**/output.mp4 (about 240 MB of .mp4 files). If you're cloning the full repo for development, install Git LFS first: # macOS brew install git-lfs # Ubuntu / Debian sudo apt install git-lfs # Windows winget install GitHub.GitLFS # Then, once per machine git lfs install If you only need source files, you can skip LFS content: GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git License Apache 2.0
tldr: HeyGen 开源 HyperFrames，用 HTML 编写视频，专为 AI Agent 设计
objective_summary: HeyGen 发布开源框架 HyperFrames，允许开发者用 HTML、CSS 和可搜索动画编写视频并通过 CLI 或 AI Agent 渲染为确定性 MP4。核心通过 headless Chrome 逐帧捕获、FFmpeg 编码，无需构建步骤，支持 GSAP、Lottie、Three.
key_logic_flow: HyperFrames 是 HeyGen 开源的 HTML 转视频框架，通过 HTML 数据属性定义视频合成，支持 CLI 本地使用、AI Agent 技能调用和托管工作流三种模式。
视频合成流程为：用 HTML + CSS + 可搜索动画编写合成文件，在浏览器中预览，由 headless Chrome 逐帧捕获后经 FFmpeg 编码为确定性 MP4 输出。
音频和视频轨道通过 data-start、data-duration、data-track-index 等数据属性控制，支持 GSAP、CSS 动画、Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、WAAPI 等多动画库适配器。
与 Remotion 的关键区别在于创作模型：HyperFrames 使用纯 HTML（无需构建步骤、Agent 可直接编写），Remotion 使用 React 组件（需打包器、JSX 项目结构）。
生态系统包括 CLI、核心引擎、目录组件库、Agent 技能包、Studio 编辑器、Player Web 组件、AWS Lambda 分布式渲染以及 frame.md 设计系统转换层。
HyperFrames 已在 HeyGen 生产环境中使用，社区采用者包括 tldraw、TanStack 等团队，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，无按次渲染费用或商业使用门槛。

impact_score.reason: HeyGen 开源 HyperFrames 是一个重要的行业事件。它用纯 HTML 替代 React 组件作为视频合成的基本单元，消除了 Remotion 所需的构建步骤，使 AI Agent 和开发者都能直接编写视频 HTML。Apache 2.0 许可+无商业门槛直接挑战 Remotion 的生态位，且已在 HeyGen 生产环境及 tldraw、TanStack 等团队验证。这不是范式转移（如 ChatGPT），但足以改变程序化视频生成领域的竞争格局，尤其是随着 AI coding agent 的普及，HTML-native 的创作模型可能成为新标准。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 无需构建步骤的纯 HTML 视频合成，AI Agent 可直接编写和渲染

hype_assessment.reason: 文章没有使用'颠覆性''革命性'等 PR 泡沫词汇，而是清晰地描述了技术架构（headless Chrome逐帧捕获+FFmpeg编码）、与 Remotion 的客观对比、以及各模块的状态（部分可用、部分演化中）。Apache 2.0 许可和已有生产案例也增强了可信度。'Agent-native'是合理的差异化定位而非空泛概念包装。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 核心创新在于 HTML-native 创作模型：通过 HTML data 属性（data-start、data-duration、data-track-index）定义视频合成时间线，结合适配器模式支持 GSAP/Lottie/Three.js 等多动画库，无需打包器即可在浏览器中直接预览。frame.md 设计系统转换层进一步将品牌规范转化为 AI Agent 可理解的视频构图指令。
domain_disruption.business_model: Apache 2.0 全开源+无按次渲染费用直接瓦解了程序化视频领域的商业护城河。HeyGen 的意图是通过开源建立生态标准（类似于 React 之于前端），然后通过托管工作流、Studio 编辑器等增值服务变现，而非卖渲染次数。这迫使 Remotion 等竞品重新思考定价策略，并可能加速整个 AI 视频生成工具链的商品化。

compound_value.reason: HyperFrames 的长期复利价值体现在它试图成为 AI Agent 生成视频的标准化基础设施层。核心投资逻辑有三：(1) 创作模型差异化——纯 HTML 无构建步骤，AI Agent 天然擅长写 HTML/JS，这比 Remotion 的 React JSX 方案在 agent-native 场景下有显著优势，且 Apache 2.0 零费用消除了商业采用门槛；(2) 生态初步成形——CLI、Agent Skills（已适配 Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini CLI）、Studio 编辑器、AWS Lambda 分布式渲染、frame.md 设计系统转换层、Catalog 组件库，六个模块覆盖了从创作到生产的全链路；(3) 生产验证——已在 HeyGen 内部服役，tldraw、TanStack 等团队已采用，说明非 HeyGen 生态也有实际需求。风险在于：(a) 视频生成的 agent 工作流尚处于极早期，市场规模不确定；(b) Remotion 已有更成熟的社区和商业化路径（Remotion Premium）；(c) 纯 HTML 方案在复杂多轨合成场景下可能不如 React 组件体系灵活。总体判断：如果 AI Agent 写视频成为趋势，HyperFrames 有潜力成为该赛道的 HTML-first 标准，3-5 年内价值持续增长，但目前需关注社区增长速度和商业化路径的验证。

market_opportunities: AI Agent 集成商可基于 HyperFrames 的 Agent Skill 包，构建"一句话生成营销视频"的自动化内容管线，按订阅或按量向中小团队收费
前端开发者/工作室可围绕 HyperFrames 目录组件生态，开发可复用的动画过渡、数据可视化、社媒模板等商业化组件，复用其开源渲染引擎
企业品牌团队可落地 frame.md 设计系统转换层，将 Web 设计 Token 映射为视频帧规范，实现产品宣发物料的规模化自动生产

risk_matrix.regulatory: Apache 2.0 许可无商业使用门槛，但若超分发的视频包含未授权素材（字体、音乐、图像），使用者仍面临版权诉讼风险；AI Agent 自主生成的视频内容可能涉及虚假信息责任归属问题
risk_matrix.technological: Headless Chrome 逐帧渲染计算资源密集，高清长视频的渲染成本和时间可能成为规模化瓶颈；如果 WebCodecs 等浏览器原生编码 API 成熟，当前架构存在被替代的可能性
risk_matrix.competitive: Remotion 已在程序化视频领域建立强大生态和社区认知，HyperFrames 的纯 HTML 路线虽对 Agent 更友好，但需从零构建组件生态和开发者信任；Canva、Adobe、CapCut 等巨头可能快速跟进类似能力
risk_matrix.ethical: 框架本身是工具层面的渲染引擎，但当 Agent 自主组装媒体素材时，可能被用于生成误导性政宣视频或深度伪造内容，且责任链条不清晰

title: zai-org/GLM-5
description: GLM-5: From Vibe Coding to Agentic EngineeringGLM-5.2 & GLM-5.1 & GLM-5 👋 Join our Wechat or Discord community. 📖 Check out the GLM-5.2 blog and GLM-5 Technical report. 📍 Use GLM-5.2 API services on Z.ai API Platform. 🔜 Try GLM-5.2 at z.ai. Introduction GLM-5.2 GLM-5.2, our latest flagship model for long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and, for the first time, delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. GLM-5.2's new capabilities include: Solid 1M Context: A solid 1M-token context that stably sustains long-horizon work Advanced Coding with Flexible Effort: Stronger coding capabilities with multiple thinking effort levels to balance performance and latency Improved Architecture: We propose IndexShare, which reuses the same indexer across every four sparse attention layers, reducing per-token FLOPs by 2.9× at a 1M context length. We also improve GLM-5.2’s MTP layer for speculative decoding, increasing the acceptance length by up to 20% On standard coding benchmarks, GLM-5.2 is the strongest open-source model, improving on GLM-5.1 by a wide margin: 81.0 vs. 62.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 62.1 vs. 58.4 on SWE-bench Pro. It also closes much of the gap to the closed-source frontier — on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (81.0) it lands within a few points of Claude Opus 4.8 (85.0) — while staying ahead of Gemini 3.1 Pro. For more detail, check our blog. GLM-5.1 GLM-5.1 is our next-generation flagship model for agentic engineering, with significantly stronger coding capabilities than its predecessor. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Pro and leads GLM-5 by a wide margin on NL2Repo (repo generation) and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (real-world terminal tasks). But the most meaningful leap goes beyond first-pass performance. Previous models—including GLM-5—tend to exhaust their repertoire early: they apply familiar techniques for quick initial gains, then plateau. Giving them more time doesn't help. GLM-5.1, by contrast, is built to stay effective on agentic tasks over much longer horizons. We've found that the model handles ambiguous problems with better judgment and stays productive over longer sessions. It breaks complex problems down, runs experiments, reads results, and identifies blockers with real precision. By revisiting its reasoning and revising its strategy through repeated iteration, GLM-5.1 sustains optimization over hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls. The longer it runs, the better the result. GLM-5 We are launching GLM-5, targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. Scaling is still one of the most important ways to improve the intelligence efficiency of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Compared to GLM-4.5, GLM-5 scales from 355B parameters (32B active) to 744B parameters (40B active), and increases pre-training data from 23T to 28.5T tokens. GLM-5 also integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), largely reducing deployment cost while preserving long-context capacity. Reinforcement learning aims to bridge the gap between competence and excellence in pre-trained models. However, deploying it at scale for LLMs is a challenge due to the RL training inefficiency. To this end, we developed slime, a novel asynchronous RL infrastructure that substantially improves training throughput and efficiency, enabling more fine-grained post-training iterations. With advances in both pre-training and post-training, GLM-5 delivers significant improvement compared to GLM-4.7 across a wide range of academic benchmarks and achieves best-in-class performance among all open-source models in the world on reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks, closing the gap with frontier models. GLM-5 is purpose-built for complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. On our internal evaluation suite CC-Bench-V2, GLM-5 significantly outperforms GLM-4.7 across frontend, backend, and long-horizon tasks, narrowing the gap to Claude Opus 4.5. On Vending Bench 2, a benchmark that measures long-term operational capability, GLM-5 ranks #1 among open-source models. Vending Bench 2 requires the model to run a simulated vending machine business over a one-year horizon; GLM-5 finishes with a final account balance of $4,432, approaching Claude Opus 4.5 and demonstrating strong long-term planning and resource management. Feel free to try them out: SGLang (v0.5.13.post1+) — see cookbook vLLM (v0.23.0+) — see recipes Transformers (v0.5.12+) — see transformers docs KTransformers (v0.5.12+) — see tutorial For deployment on the Ascend NPU platform, inference frameworks such as vLLM-Ascend, xLLM and SGLang are supported — see here. GLM-5 supports controlling the thinking budget through the reasoning_effort parameter, which accepts two levels: max and high. max is the default — if reasoning_effort is left unset (or set to any value other than high), the model runs at Max. To use the High level, you must explicitly pass reasoning_effort="high". For default scenarios such as benchmark/leaderboard reproduction, keep Max (no setting required); only set reasoning_effort="high" when you specifically want the High level. Thinking can be turned off entirely by setting enable_thinking=false. tldr: 智谱AI发布GLM-5系列旗舰模型，支持百万token上下文和强编码能力
objective_summary: 智谱AI（zai-org）发布GLM-5、GLM-5.1、GLM-5.2三代模型。GLM-5.2支持100万token稳定上下文，采用IndexShare架构将长上下文计算量降低2.9倍，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上得分81.0，逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0）。
key_logic_flow: 智谱AI发布GLM-5系列三代模型（GLM-5、GLM-5.1、GLM-5.2），定位复杂系统工程和长周期智能体任务。
GLM-5.2首次实现稳定的100万token上下文窗口，并支持可调节思考强度的编码能力（Max/High两档）。
GLM-5.2采用IndexShare架构，每四层稀疏注意力共享同一索引器，在100万上下文下将单token FLOPs降低2.9倍。
GLM-5.2在Terminal-Bench 2.1上得分81.0，大幅领先GLM-5.1（62.0），接近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），超越Gemini 3.1 Pro。
GLM-5.1擅长长周期智能体任务，能在数百轮交互和数千次工具调用中持续优化策略，SWE-Bench Pro和Vending Bench 2上达到开源模型最佳水平。
GLM-5拥有7440亿参数（400亿活跃参数），集成DeepSeek Sparse Attention，并开发异步强化学习基础设施SLiME以提升后训练效率。

impact_score.reason: 智谱AI一次性发布GLM-5/5.1/5.2三代模型，744B参数（40B活跃）的开源MoE模型在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到81.0分，逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），超越Gemini 3.1 Pro，这是开源模型在agentic编码任务上对闭源前沿最有力的追赶之一。但模型并未实现超越，且智谱在开源社区的全球影响力仍弱于DeepSeek、Meta等玩家，属于重要的局部竞争格局变化（尤其在中国市场和开源社区），而非行业范式转移。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 开源模型在编码和agentic任务上能否复现宣称的基准测试成绩

hype_assessment.reason: 文章提供了具体的架构创新（IndexShare、SLiME）、详尽的基准测试对比和部署框架支持列表，技术含量扎实。但'closing the gap to frontier'、'best-in-class among all open-source models'属于标准PR话术，Terminal-Bench和Vending Bench等自建基准的权威性尚待第三方验证，存在一定包装成分。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: IndexShare架构通过每四层稀疏注意力共享同一索引器，在100万token上下文下将单token FLOPs降低2.9倍，是对长上下文推理效率的实质性工程优化；异步强化学习框架SLiME提升了后训练吞吐量，使更细粒度的迭代成为可能。
domain_disruption.business_model: 开源744B参数模型在编码和agentic任务上逼近GPT/Claude闭源前沿，可能加速中国企业降低对美国AI模型供应商的技术依赖，同时推动AI应用从'聊天式'向'长周期自主agent'方向演进，重塑企业对AI模型的选型标准和部署模式。

compound_value.reason: GLM-5系列在技术上取得了真实进步：IndexShare架构将长上下文计算量降低2.9倍、实现稳定百万token上下文、Terminal-Bench 81.0逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），这些都是有工程价值的创新。但从VC视角看，开放权重模型赛道已高度拥挤（DeepSeek、Qwen、Llama、Mistral群雄并立），模型本身作为商品的正反馈效应有限。GLM-5的开源策略意味着商业变现主要依赖API平台（z.ai），而非模型权重本身。SLiME异步RL基础设施和IndexShare架构是稀缺的技术资产，可能为智谱在Agent长周期任务场景建立差异化，但其长期复利取决于能否将技术领先转化为开发者生态和API收入飞轮，而非模型权重分发。整体评估：有真实技术价值但处于激烈红海，复利效应中等偏上。需要持续观察后续模型迭代速度和API商业化进展。评分6.5反映了'值得跟踪但不下重注'的VC判断。

competitive_casualty: 其他中小型中国AI模型厂商
market_opportunities: 企业可基于GLM-5.2的百万token上下文窗口，构建面向大型代码仓库和复杂系统工程的全量代码理解与重构工具，替代多次切片+拼接的传统方案
创业者可利用GLM-5.1的长周期智能体能力，开发自动化运维和DevOps智能体产品，在数百轮交互中持续优化部署策略和故障排查
开源特性（HuggingFace/ModelScope可下载）为中小团队提供了低成本接入前沿模型的路径，可聚焦垂直行业的微调部署和私有化服务

risk_matrix.regulatory: GLM系列由中国企业（智谱AI）开发，在欧美市场部署可能面临地缘政治相关的出口管制或数据合规审查（如AI Act高风险分类体系下的合规成本）；开源模型的许可证条款需仔细审查以避免商用风险
risk_matrix.technological: IndexShare架构虽降低2.9倍FLOPs，但DeepSeek Sparse Attention等竞品已有类似稀疏注意力方案，技术独特性有待验证；长上下文真实生产环境中的检索精度和幻觉控制能力仍需独立评测确认
risk_matrix.competitive: DeepSeek、Claude Opus、Gemini等均在大规模编码和智能体赛道激烈竞争，开源大模型（744B参数级别）日益商品化，差异化窗口可能收窄；Terminal-Bench 2.1得分81.0虽接近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0）但仍有差距
risk_matrix.ethical: 7440亿参数的超大规模模型训练和推理带来显著能源消耗与环境影响；强编码与智能体能力可能被用于自动化攻击开发和漏洞利用等恶意用途

tldr: GitHub 仓库汇总了 Claude、GPT、Gemini 等主要 AI 模型的系统提示词，被华盛顿邮报引用。
objective_summary: asgeirtj 在 GitHub 上维护了一个系统提示词泄露仓库，收录了 Claude Fable 5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4.3 等数十个 AI 模型的 system prompt。该仓库于 2026 年 5 月 11 日被华盛顿邮报引用，截至 2026
key_logic_flow: asgeirtj 在 GitHub 上创建了 system_prompts_leaks 仓库，专门收集和归档各大 AI 聊天机器人的系统提示词。
该仓库覆盖了 Anthropic（Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8 等）、OpenAI（GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4 等）、Google（Gemini 3.5 Flash、3.1 Pro 等）、xAI（Grok 4.3 等）等多个主流 AI 厂商的模型。
除了核心模型提示词，仓库还收录了 Claude Code、Codex CLI、GitHub Copilot 等开发工具以及 Copilot for macOS、Zed AI 等桌面应用的 system prompt。
仓库还提供了 Claude Opus 4.8 到 Fable 5 的 diff 对比，标明每个版本的发布日期和官方来源链接。
该仓库在 2026 年 5 月 11 日被华盛顿邮报引用作为报道素材。
截至 2026 年 6 月 18 日，该仓库仍在持续更新，最新收录了 Claude Design、GPT-5.5 Codex 和 GitHub Copilot macOS app 的系统提示词。

impact_score.reason: 该仓库首次系统化收集了 Claude、GPT、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 模型的数十个版本 system prompt，并提供版本间 diff 对比，被华盛顿邮报引用作为报道素材。虽然不是技术创新，但作为首个跨厂商、跨版本的 AI 系统提示词可审计档案，对提示工程研究、AI 安全分析和模型行为透明度有独特价值。主流媒体的引用表明其影响力已出圈。但本质是文档归档项目，未改变行业竞争格局或技术范式。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 跨模型系统提示词透明度和版本演化追踪，便于逆向工程和提示策略研究

hype_assessment.reason: 该仓库为纯文档归档项目，内容组织方式客观平实，未使用任何夸张宣传语或 PR 话术。所有收录内容均附官方来源链接和发布日期，可独立验证。华盛顿邮报引用进一步佐证其内容可信度。不存在概念包装或水分。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 暂无技术突破。但通过系统化收集和版本 diff 对比（如 Opus 4.8 → Fable 5），为社区提供了首个跨厂商 system prompt 演化档案，对 AI 安全研究、提示工程和模型行为审计有重要参考价值。
domain_disruption.business_model: 揭示各厂商模型的行为约束、安全策略和风格偏好差异，为 AI 产品的竞争策略分析提供了透明度依据。间接影响企业自身提示词策略的保护与迭代，推动行业从'黑盒'向'可审计'方向演进。

compound_value.reason: 该仓库作为 AI 系统提示词的集中归档库，具有显著的长期复利效应：（1）网络效应强——收录的模型越多，对研究者和开发者的参考价值越大，进而吸引更多贡献者提交新发现；（2）时间维度上不可逆——每次模型更新都被记录为 diff（如 Opus 4.8→Fable 5），形成业界唯一的系统性演进档案，学术价值和竞争情报价值随时间递增；（3）已被华盛顿邮报作为信源引用，说明其已获得主流媒体背书，奠定了行业透明度基础设施的地位；（4）横向覆盖范围极广——从基础模型到开发者工具（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Copilot）再到垂直应用（Docker Gordon、Zed AI），使其成为跨层级的综合性知识资产。风险点：（a）纯社区驱动，缺乏商业化和可持续性保障；（b）面临法律压力，AI 公司可能通过 DMCA 或 TOS 施压；（c）如果未来模型架构发生根本性变化（如不再依赖显式 system prompt），该资产价值可能大幅缩水。综合来看，3-5 年内大概率是 AI 系统行为透明度的基石性参考，但并非可货币化的商业资产。

key_beneficiaries: 小型 AI 模型公司
competitive_casualty: 闭源提示词工程咨询公司
依赖提示词黑盒策略的 AI 公司

AI应用开发者可通过对比不同版本模型的系统提示词差异（如Opus 4.8→Fable 5），快速洞察大模型厂商的产品策略转向，指导自身产品与特定模型行为的对齐开发
系统提示词工程师可将该仓库作为行业基准库，开发自动化的提示词合规检查服务，为企业提供符合AI Act等监管要求的系统提示词优化建议

risk_matrix.regulatory: 各AI厂商可能依据版权法和商业秘密保护条款对系统提示词仓库发起DMCA下架请求；欧盟AI Act对基础模型提供商的透明度要求与该仓库的未经授权披露行为存在法律冲突；若提示词中隐含用户数据处理逻辑，可能触发GDPR数据泄露审查
risk_matrix.technological: 系统提示词迭代极快，仓库中收录的旧版本提示词可能已过期，基于过时提示词的分析结论可能产生误导；厂商可能转向在服务端硬编码行为逻辑而非通过客户端提示词暴露，削弱该仓库的信息价值
risk_matrix.competitive: 头部AI厂商的核心提示词被公开后，差异化竞争壁垒被削弱，中小厂商可低成本复制头部产品的行为风格和工具调用策略，加速行业同质化竞争
risk_matrix.ethical: 公开的系统提示词可被用于精确的提示词注入攻击和模型越狱研究，放大深度伪造、不当内容生成等滥用风险；提示词中反映的AI行为偏差（如对特定群体的刻板印象设定）被公开展示可能加剧对AI公平性的舆论压力

title: BuilderIO/agent-native
description: A framework for building agent-native applications.Agent-Native Open-source framework for agentic applications you own. Don't choose between rich user interfaces and autonomous agents. Every Agent-Native app is both. Agents and UIs — Fully Connected The agent and the UI are equal citizens of the same system. Every action works both ways — click it or ask for it. Everything syncs — Agent and UI share one database and one state. Changes from either side show up instantly on the other. Real-time multiplayer — Humans and agents collaborate in the same document simultaneously: CRDT merging, live presence (cursors, selection rings, who's on which slide), and the agent as a first-class peer editor. Works on any SQL database and any host, including serverless. Context-aware — The agent knows what you're looking at. Select text, hit Cmd+I, and tell it what to do. Per-user workspace — Skills, memory, instructions, sub-agents, and MCP servers — SQL-backed, customizable per user. Claude-Code-level flexibility, SaaS-grade economics. Agents call agents — Tag another agent from any app. They discover each other over A2A and take action across your stack. Reusable integrations — Connect a provider once in Dispatch, keep secret values in the vault, then grant apps like Brain, Analytics, Mail, and Dispatch access to the shared account metadata and credential refs. Three shapes — Build the same agent as a headless API, a rich chat experience, or a full application where agent and UI stay in sync. Apps that improve themselves — Your apps get better on their own. The agent can add features, fix bugs, and refine the UI over time. Any database, any host — Any SQL database Drizzle supports. Any hosting target Nitro supports. No lock-in. Bring the agent surface you need — MCP-compatible hosts can call your apps, coding agents can install skills, native chat renders reusable app outputs, and BYO agent runtimes can stream into the Agent-Native chat shell. The framework for agent-native apps Agent-Native is an open-source framework for building robust agents that can act inside real apps, not just chat next to them. It gives you primitives for product-grade agentic software: shared actions, SQL-backed state, identity, tools, skills, jobs, observability, and UI surfaces that all work together. Backend agnostic: bring your own database, hosting provider, model stack, and app code. // One action powers UI, agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI. export default defineAction({ schema: z.object({ emailId: z.string(), body: z.string(), }), run: async ({ emailId, body }) => { await db.insert(replies).values({ emailId, body }); }, }); Actions — Define work once. Use it from UI, agent, API, MCP, A2A, and CLI. Agent runtime — Chat, tools, skills, memory, jobs, observability, and handoffs ship together. Backend agnostic — Plug in any Drizzle-supported SQL database and Nitro-compatible host. One agent, three product shapes Agent-Native primitives let you choose how much UI to put around an agent without rebuilding the agent contract: Shape What you ship Same primitives underneath Headless Call the agent and actions from code, CLI, HTTP, MCP, or A2A. defineAction, auth, skills, memory, jobs, observability Rich chat A standalone or embedded chat with native tables, charts, approvals, setup flows, and tool results. Shared chat runtime, BYO runtime adapters, action-declared native renderers Whole app A full SaaS/product UI where chat can start central, move to the sidebar, and stay synced with app state. SQL state, actions, context awareness, deep links, live sync Protocols come with the framework instead of becoming separate integrations per feature. Today that means A2A, MCP, MCP Apps, standard remote MCP OAuth, MCP clients, HTTP/CLI action calls, native chat widgets, AgentChatRuntime adapters, standard OpenAI, AG-UI, Claude Agent SDK, and Vercel AI SDK chat runtime connectors, and deep links all hang off the same action surface. ACP is best understood as the coding-agent/editor interoperability protocol, not the general BYO app-chat runtime. For the full decision guide — headless, rich chat on the built-in agent, rich chat on your own agent, embedded sidecar, or full app — see Agent Surfaces. To connect Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, or another MCP host to your hosted app, see the External Agents guide. Try it with a skill Don't want to scaffold a whole app yet? Add visual planning and PR recaps to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, and similar agents with one command: npx @agent-native/core@latest skills add visual-plan You get two slash commands that upgrade how your agent plans and reports its work: /visual-plan — before the agent writes code, it opens a structured, reviewable plan document instead of a wall of text: inline diagrams, UI wireframes and prototypes, file-by-file implementation maps, and annotations you can comment on and approve. /visual-recap — after changes land, it turns a PR or git diff into a high-altitude visual recap: schema, API, and file changes rendered as grounded before/after blocks with a shareable review link, instead of scrolling a raw diff. See the Skills Guide for more skills and local installs. Templates Start with a full featured template. Each one is a complete, 100% free and open-source SaaS app — cloneable, not scaffolded — except you own the code and can customize everything. Calendar Agent-Native Google Calendar, Calendly Manage events, sync with Google Calendar, and share a public booking page with AI scheduling. Content Open-source Obsidian for MDX Edit local Markdown/MDX files, generate rich interactive custom blocks, and draft, rewrite, or publish with an agent. Plans Visual plan mode for coding agents Install /visual-plan and /visual-recap so your coding agent can plan before it builds and recap changes after they land — high-level code reviews with diagrams, wireframes, annotations, and review links. Slides Agent-Native Google Slides, Pitch Generate and edit React-based presentations via prompt or point-and-click. Analytics Agent-Native Amplitude, Mixpanel Connect analytics data sources, prompt for real charts, and build reusable dashboards. Shared workspace connections can provide provider credentials, while Analytics still owns metrics, source-of-truth choices, and saved analyses. Clips Agent-Native Loom Record your screen with auto-transcripts, shareable links, and an agent that summarizes, captions, and edits clips on demand. Every template is a complete cloneable SaaS — fork it, customize it with the agent, own it. Try them with example data before connecting your own sources. View the full template gallery at agent-native.com/templates. Quick Start One command to fork a template and start building locally. npx @agent-native/core@latest create my-platform cd my-platform pnpm install pnpm dev The CLI shows a multi-select picker so you can include as many templates as you want in one workspace. Pick Mail + Calendar + Forms and you get all three apps wired up and sharing auth in one go. Or browse the template gallery for live demos. Want a single app, no monorepo? Use --standalone: npx @agent-native/core@latest create my-app --standalone --template mail Workspaces (Monorepo) A workspace is the default shape of an agent-native project. Every app sits under apps/, and packages/shared/ is available for the small amount of code, instructions, skills, or branding that should truly apply to every app. my-platform/ ├── package.json # declares `agent-native.workspaceCore` ├── pnpm-workspace.yaml ├── .env # shared secrets: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, BUILDER_PRIVATE_KEY, A2A_SECRET, ... ├── packages/ │ └── shared/ # optional shared custom code └── apps/ ├── mail/ ├── calendar/ └── forms/ Add another app later: npx @agent-native/core@latest add-app notes --template content Deploy every app behind one origin: npx @agent-native/core@latest deploy # https://your-agents.com/mail/* → mail # https://your-agents.com/calendar/* → calendar # https://your-agents.com/forms/* → forms Same-origin deploy means a shared login session across every app and zero-config cross-app A2A — tag @mail from the calendar's agent chat and it just works (no JWT signing, no CORS). Full details at agent-native.com/docs/multi-app-workspace. The Best of Both Worlds SaaS Tools Raw AI Agents Internal Tools Agent-Native UI Polished but rigid None Mixed quality Full UI, fork & go AI Bolted on Powerful Shallowly connected Agent-first, integrated Customization Can't Instructions and skills Full, but high maintenance Agent modifies the app Ownership Rented Somewhat yours You own the code You own the code Community Join the Discord to ask questions, share what you're building, and get help. Docs Full documentation at agent-native.com. License MIT
tldr: BuilderIO 发布 Agent-Native 开源框架，让 AI Agent 与 UI 在应用中平权协作。
objective_summary: BuilderIO 于 2026 年 6 月发布 Agent-Native 开源框架，允许开发者构建 Agent 与 UI 共享状态和数据库的应用程序。框架提供 Actions、Agent 运行时、SQL 状态管理等原语，支持 MCP、A2A、HTTP/CLI 等多协议接入，采用 MIT 许可证。
key_logic_flow: BuilderIO 发布 Agent-Native 开源框架，核心设计理念是 Agent 和 UI 互为平等公民，共享同一个数据库和状态。
框架提供 defineAction 原语，一个动作定义可同时支持 UI、Agent、HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI 六种调用面。
支持三种构建形态：纯 Headless API、丰富聊天界面、以及 Agent 和 UI 实时同步的全功能应用。
内置实时多人协作能力，基于 CRDT 合并、光标/选区/页面级别的同步协作，Agent 作为一等编辑参与者。
框架提供 MCP、A2A、标准 OpenAI、AG-UI、Claude Agent SDK、Vercel AI SDK 等多种协议和运行时的接入适配器。
支持任何 Drizzle 兼容的 SQL 数据库和任何 Nitro 兼容的主机部署，采用 MIT 开源许可证。

impact_score.reason: 该框架提出的'Agent与UI平权'设计理念具有架构层面的创新性，defineAction 原语一次定义同时暴露六种调用面（UI/Agent/HTTP/MCP/A2A/CLI），降低了构建AI原生应用的多协议适配成本。但BuilderIO在开发者生态中的影响力不及Meta、OpenAI等巨头，框架尚处早期发布阶段，缺乏大规模生产验证。评分理由：短期内会对Agent应用开发范式产生局部影响，改变开发者构建AI应用时'先选UI还是先选Agent'的决策路径，但尚未达到行业范式转移级别。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: defineAction 原语一次定义、多面暴露的设计能否真正消除UI和Agent之间的集成摩擦

hype_assessment.reason: 文中使用了'Don't choose between'、'Everything syncs'、'Apps that improve themselves'等包装性表述，存在一定概念放大。但整体有真实代码、可运行模板（Scheduling、CMS、Slide Deck等）和MIT开源协议作为支撑，并非空谈，属于'有干货但做了包装'的中等程度。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: defineAction 原语实现了单一动作定义自动暴露为UI回调、Agent工具调用、HTTP API、MCP服务、A2A协议和CLI命令六个调用面，消除了传统多协议适配的开发开销。同时CRDT驱动的实时同步让Agent和UI共享同一个SQL数据库状态，Agent可以作为一等协作者参与实时多人编辑，这在框架层面是首创的设计模式。
domain_disruption.business_model: MIT开源许可降低了企业采用门槛，预构建的完整SaaS模板（Scheduling、CMS、Slide Deck等）提供了一种'可克隆的SaaS应用'新分发模式，可能改变AI应用创业的启动方式——从'用ChatGPT包装API'转向'基于Agent-Native框架构建Agent与UI协同的全功能应用'。

compound_value.reason: Agent-Native 解决了一个在 AI 应用架构中日益尖锐的核心矛盾：Agent 交互和 UI 交互长期被割裂为两套系统。框架提出的 '一个 defineAction 同时服务 UI、Agent、HTTP、MCP、A2A、CLI 六种调用面' 的设计模式，如果被市场接受，可能成为新一代 AI 应用的标准架构范式。其长期复利效应体现在三方面：一是协议无关的多态接入（MCP/A2A/OpenAI/Claude SDK/Vercel AI SDK），避免了生态绑定风险，适配性极强；二是 CRDT 实时多人协作 + Agent 作为一等编辑参与者的设计，抓住了多 Agent 协作这个确定性趋势；三是 MIT 开源 + 完整 SaaS 模板（Scheduling、Present、Analytics 等）降低了采用门槛，有利于病毒式传播。风险点在于 BuilderIO 过往项目（Mitosis、Qwik）并未取得统治级市场份额，且该框架需要开发者接受全新的应用架构思路，学习曲线存在。综合评估，有潜力成为 Agent 原生应用的事实标准基础设施，但需观察未来 6-12 个月的社区采用率和贡献者活跃度来验证这一判断。

competitive_casualty: 传统 RPA 平台（UiPath、Automation Anywhere）
孤立的无代码/低代码平台
仅支持单一 Agent 协议入口的 Agent 框架
market_opportunities: SaaS 创业者可基于 Agent-Native 框架快速构建"Agent 与 UI 平权"的下一代应用，显著降低 agentic 功能的集成成本，尤其是在协作编辑、日程管理和数据分析等场景
企业软件开发团队可利用 defineAction 原语实现一次开发覆盖 UI、API、MCP、A2A 六种调用面，大幅减少重复开发维护成本，建议关注内部工具平台的 Agent-Native 化改造
围绕该框架的技能（Skills）市场和集成适配器生态存在早期机会，开发者可开发垂直行业专用的 Agent 技能包（如法律文档审查、医疗排程），复用框架的运行时和协作基础设施

risk_matrix.regulatory: Agent 具备自我改进和自动修改应用代码的能力，在受监管行业（金融、医疗）可能引发合规审查；多用户协作场景下 Agent 作为一等编辑参与者对用户数据的访问权限需满足 GDPR/个保法的数据最小化原则
risk_matrix.technological: 框架重度依赖 Drizzle（SQL ORM）和 Nitro（部署层）生态，若两者出现兼容性断裂或性能瓶颈将直接影响框架可用性；'Apps that improve themselves' 的自修改机制在生产环境中的稳定性和安全边界尚未经大规模验证
risk_matrix.competitive: 该领域竞争激烈：Vercel AI SDK（同赛道且生态更成熟）、LangChain（Agent 框架先发优势）、以及 Google/OpenAI 的原生 Agent 能力都在争夺同一开发者心智。BuilderIO 虽开源且 MIT 许可，但社区规模和品牌影响力面临挑战
risk_matrix.ethical: Agent 作为一等编辑参与者可实时修改文档和应用行为，可能导致用户对 AI 自主决策边界失去控制感；CRDT 合并下 Agent 的操作与人类操作混合，审计追踪和责任归属尚不清晰

[2023/12/02] added support for safetensors. Now support all top 10 models in open llm leaderboard. [2023/12/01] airllm 2.0. Support compressions: 3x run time speed up! [2023/11/20] airllm Initial version! Star History Table of Contents Quick start Model Compression Configurations Run on MacOS Example notebooks Supported Models Acknowledgement FAQ Quickstart 1. Install package First, install the airllm pip package. pip install airllm 2. Inference Then, initialize AirLLMLlama2, pass in the huggingface repo ID of the model being used, or the local path, and inference can be performed similar to a regular transformer model. (You can also specify the path to save the splitted layered model through layer_shards_saving_path when init AirLLMLlama2. from airllm import AutoModel MAX_LENGTH = 128 # could use hugging face model repo id: model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("garage-bAInd/Platypus2-70B-instruct") # or use model's local path... #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("/home/ubuntu/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--garage-bAInd--Platypus2-70B-instruct/snapshots/b585e74bcaae02e52665d9ac6d23f4d0dbc81a0f") input_text = [ 'What is the capital of United States?', #'I like', ] input_tokens = model.tokenizer(input_text, return_tensors="pt", return_attention_mask=False, truncation=True, max_length=MAX_LENGTH, padding=False) generation_output = model.generate( input_tokens['input_ids'].cuda(), max_new_tokens=20, use_cache=True, return_dict_in_generate=True) output = model.tokenizer.decode(generation_output.sequences[0]) print(output) Note: During inference, the original model will first be decomposed and saved layer-wise. Please ensure there is sufficient disk space in the huggingface cache directory. Model Compression - 3x Inference Speed Up! We just added model compression based on block-wise quantization-based model compression. Which can further speed up the inference speed for up to 3x , with almost ignorable accuracy loss! (see more performance evaluation and why we use block-wise quantization in this paper) How to enable model compression speed up: Step 1. make sure you have bitsandbytes installed by pip install -U bitsandbytes Step 2. make sure airllm verion later than 2.0.0: pip install -U airllm Step 3. when initialize the model, passing the argument compression ('4bit' or '8bit'): model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("garage-bAInd/Platypus2-70B-instruct", compression='4bit' # specify '8bit' for 8-bit block-wise quantization ) What are the differences between model compression and quantization? Quantization normally needs to quantize both weights and activations to really speed things up. Which makes it harder to maintain accuracy and avoid the impact of outliers in all kinds of inputs. While in our case the bottleneck is mainly at the disk loading, we only need to make the model loading size smaller. So, we get to only quantize the weights' part, which is easier to ensure the accuracy. Configurations When initialize the model, we support the following configurations: compression: supported options: 4bit, 8bit for 4-bit or 8-bit block-wise quantization, or by default None for no compression profiling_mode: supported options: True to output time consumptions or by default False layer_shards_saving_path: optionally another path to save the splitted model hf_token: huggingface token can be provided here if downloading gated models like: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf prefetching: prefetching to overlap the model loading and compute. By default, turned on. For now, only AirLLMLlama2 supports this. delete_original: if you don't have too much disk space, you can set delete_original to true to delete the original downloaded hugging face model, only keep the transformed one to save half of the disk space. MacOS Just install airllm and run the code the same as on linux. See more in Quick Start. make sure you installed mlx and torch you probably need to install python native see more here only Apple silicon is supported Example [python notebook] tldr: AirLLM 可在 4GB 单 GPU 上运行 70B 大模型，无需量化剪枝，支持 405B 模型在 8GB 显存推理。
objective_summary: lyogavin 开发的开源工具 AirLLM，通过逐层分解和块级量化压缩技术，优化推理内存占用，使得 70B 大模型可在 4GB 单 GPU 上运行，405B Llama3.1 可在 8GB 显存上推理。项目支持 ChatGLM、QWen、Baichuan、Mistral 等主流模型及
key_logic_flow: AirLLM 通过逐层分解模型并将每层按需加载到显存，使 70B 大模型可在 4GB 单 GPU 上推理，无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝。
v2.11.0 版本支持 Qwen2.5，v2.8.2 支持 MacOS 运行 70B 模型，v2.6 引入 AutoModel 自动检测模型类型。
2.0 版本新增基于块级量化（block-wise quantization）的模型压缩，可将推理速度提升 3 倍，仅量化权重部分以保证精度。
支持 safetensors 格式和主流开源模型，包括 ChatGLM、QWen、Baichuan、Mistral、InternLM 等。
通过 pip install airllm 安装，提供与 HuggingFace transformers 兼容的 API，支持 4bit/8bit 量化配置和 prefetching 预取加速。

impact_score.reason: AirLLM 通过逐层分解推理架构，让 70B 模型在 4GB 单 GPU、405B 模型在 8GB 显存上运行，这本质上是推理工程范式的突破——它打破了'大模型必须大显存'的硬件绑定关系。虽然并非基础理论创新（如 Transformer 论文），但其对推理部署成本的压缩效果显著，直接降低了开发者参与大模型应用的门槛。短期来看，这会推动更多个人开发者和中小团队尝试本地运行大模型，对云端 GPU 租赁市场形成一定冲击，但受限于推理速度（逐层加载的延迟瓶颈），尚不足以取代云端推理的主流地位。综合评定为 7.0 分。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 在消费级 GPU 上运行千亿参数大模型的实际可行性，以及逐层加载的推理延迟是否可接受

hype_assessment.reason: 项目宣称的'4GB 单 GPU 运行 70B 模型'和'8GB 运行 405B 模型'均有可复现的代码和版本更新日志为证，未使用'颠覆''革命性'等 PR 套话。技术方案（逐层分解 + 块级量化）有清晰的工程原理说明，性能数据（3 倍加速）来自实际实现而非理论推算。开源项目的透明性使得水分空间极小。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 逐层分解（layer-wise decomposition）推理架构，将模型按层拆分并按需加载到显存，消除了单层以外的显存占用，使推理所需显存与模型参数量解耦，不再随模型规模线性增长。配合可选的块级量化（block-wise quantization）仅对权重部分压缩，在保持精度的前提下将推理速度提升 3 倍。
domain_disruption.business_model: 大幅降低大模型本地推理的硬件门槛，使个人开发者无需依赖云端 GPU 即可运行 70B/405B 级模型，冲击以显存用量计费的云 GPU 租赁商业模式，推动 AI 推理从集中式云端向边缘/终端设备下沉，可能催生本地优先的 AI 应用生态。

compound_value.reason: AirLLM 精准切入了一个真实且持续增长的痛点：大模型推理的显存瓶颈。其逐层分解+按需加载的技术方案无需量化即可运行 70B 模型，在隐私敏感场景（医疗、金融、离线部署）和消费级硬件上有明确价值。块级量化的引入进一步提升了实用性。然而，该方案本质上是以延迟换显存，不适合高吞吐生产场景，且作为单开发者开源项目，长期维护和生态扩展存在不确定性。随着消费级 GPU 显存持续增长（5090 32GB+）和推理引擎快速演进（vLLM、llama.cpp、MLC-LLM），其相对优势将逐步收窄。属于'有用但难以自成商业'的基础设施级工具，复利效应有限，但若被 HuggingFace 等平台集成或成为开源本地推理的标准链路，仍可积累一定生态价值。

competitive_casualty: 中小型推理 API 服务商
market_opportunities: 面向中小企业或数据敏感行业（医疗、金融、政务）推出基于 AirLLM 的私有化大模型推理服务，利用现有 4GB~8GB 消费级 GPU 即可部署 70B 级模型，显著降低硬件采购门槛
围绕 AirLLM 的块级量化（block-wise quantization）技术开发模型压缩与加速工具链，为开源社区提供 4bit/8bit 量化适配服务，可封装为 SaaS 或企业级插件
在教育与科研场景中，利用 AirLLM 在 MacBook 等普通设备上运行大模型的能力，打造低成本的 LLM 教学实验平台或 Demo 快速原型工具

risk_matrix.regulatory: 涉及从 HuggingFace 下载 Llama 等受限模型权重可能触发许可条款合规问题（如 Llama 2/3 的商业许可限制），企业部署需逐模型核查许可协议
risk_matrix.technological: 逐层分解按需加载的推理方式相比整模型推理仍有显著的延迟劣势；架构创新（Mamba、MoE 等）可能降低兼容性或需要重新适配；依赖 HuggingFace 生态和 safetensors 格式，存在供应链脆弱性
risk_matrix.competitive: llama.cpp（GGML/GGUF）、Ollama、MLX、vLLM 等同赛道开源项目竞争激烈，生态和社区活跃度更高；NVIDIA、AMD 等 GPU 厂商持续提升消费级显存容量，长期可能削弱该技术的差异化价值
risk_matrix.ethical: 降低大模型本地运行门槛可能被滥用于生成有害内容或深度伪造，但本地部署方案也天然有利于数据隐私保护，属于双刃剑效应

tldr: 基于AI大模型的多市场自选股智能分析系统，每日自动推送决策仪表盘
objective_summary: ZhuLinsen 在 GitHub 上开源了 daily_stock_analysis 项目，基于 AI 大模型分析 A 股/港股/美股/日股/韩股自选股，每日生成含评分、趋势、风险警报的决策仪表盘，并推送至企业微信/飞书/Telegram/Discord/Slack/邮箱。
key_logic_flow: 该项目由 ZhuLinsen 在 GitHub 上以 MIT 许可证开源，是一个基于 AI 大模型的多市场股票智能分析系统。
系统覆盖 A 股、港股、美股、日股、韩股市场，支持行情、K 线、技术指标、资金流、新闻、公告和基本面等多维数据聚合。
每日自动生成决策仪表盘，包含核心结论、评分、趋势、买卖点位、风险警报、催化因素和操作检查清单。
分析结果支持推送到企业微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord、Slack 和邮箱共六种渠道。
支持 GitHub Actions 定时执行（每个工作日 18:00 北京时间）、Docker 部署和本地定时任务，5 分钟完成部署，无需服务器。
提供 Web 工作台，支持手动分析、任务监控、历史报告查看、Agent 策略问股、回测和持仓管理等高级功能。

impact_score.reason: 这是一个实用的开源社区项目，展示了AI大模型在金融分析场景的系统化落地，但并非行业级范式转移或重大产品发布。项目本身是对现有技术（LLM + 金融数据API + 消息推送）的工程整合，没有提出新模型架构或训练范式。影响力局限于量化投资和AI应用开发者圈层，属于日常更新中的亮点项目。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 用LLM自动化多市场股票分析全流程，从数据采集到决策仪表盘再到多渠道推送

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 无根本性技术突破，但展示了LLM在金融分析场景的高质量工程集成：支持6种AI模型提供商、7种新闻源、8种行情数据源、6种通知渠道的灵活编排，且通过GitHub Actions实现零服务器成本自动化。这种多数据源+多模型+多渠道的模块化架构设计可作为AI Agent落地参考范式。
domain_disruption.business_model: MIT开源项目，本身不构成商业模型。但该项目展示了AI+SaaS工具链替代传统金融信息服务的可行性——个人投资者可通过低成本（零服务器）获取原本需要付费投顾服务才能得到的结构化决策支持，这对量化投资工具的市场定价和分发模式有潜在冲击。

compound_value.reason: 该开源项目（MIT 许可证）展现了优秀的工程执行力和产品思维：覆盖A/港/美/日/韩多市场、6种通知渠道、15种分析策略、Agent问股、回测和Web工作台，功能完整度远超普通个人项目。但从VC视角评估复利价值有限：①MIT许可证意味着零IP壁垒，任何人都可Fork并商业化，无法形成护城河；②单一维护者模式，关键人风险极高，没有公司实体承载股权价值；③价值链条完全依赖第三方API（AI模型商+数据源），任一供应商改TOS/涨价/关停都将直接影响产品；④股票分析赛道极为拥挤，既有Wind/东方财富/同花顺等巨头，也有大量AI-native创业者涌入；⑤虽然展示了创始人的工程能力，但缺乏专有数据飞轮或网络效应来构建持续复利。综合来看是一个优秀的个人/小团队工具产品，但不符合VC追求的高复利、高壁垒、可规模化回报的标准。

高价金融数据终端零售版

面向券商或财经媒体的SaaS服务商可将此项目作为技术基座，封装为面向C端用户的AI智能投顾助手，按订阅制收费，尤其填补A股/港股市场的AI分析工具空白
该项目展示的多Agent编排思路（策略问股+回测+持仓管理）可衍生出面向量化私募的轻量级风控预警工具，聚焦盘中实时风险信号推送

risk_matrix.regulatory: 在中国境内，未经证监会批准的个人或开源项目提供证券投资分析建议可能违反《证券投资顾问业务暂行规定》。CSRC对AI生成投资建议的监管口径趋严，公开部署该系统可能有合规风险。各市场（SEC、SFC、FSA）对自动化投顾的资质要求不同，跨境使用场景需逐市场评估许可要求
risk_matrix.technological: 高度依赖外部API的可用性和稳定性（Anspire/AkShare/YFinance等），任一上游数据源变更或收费策略调整都会导致系统功能降级；LLM存在幻觉风险，可能生成错误的财务数值或技术指标解读
risk_matrix.competitive: 同赛道已有Wolfram Alpha金融插件、Bloomberg GPT、FinBERT等成熟方案，且大型券商正在自研AI投顾，开源项目在数据质量和品牌信任度上难以匹敌
risk_matrix.ethical: AI自动生成的买卖建议可能被用户盲目跟单操作，放大非理性市场行为；用户上传的自选股和持仓数据经第三方AI模型处理，存在隐私泄露风险；模型偏见可能导致对特定行业或市值区间的系统性误判

title: palmier-io/palmier-pro
description: macOS video editor built for AI Palmier Pro The video editor built for AI. Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) on Apple Silicon Palmier Pro is an open source video editor for Mac. You and your agent can generate and edit videos together inside the timeline. Swift-native video editor We built Palmier Pro from scratch with Swift. The north star is Premiere Pro, with our take on integrating AI into the workflow. Built-in Generative AI Generate videos and images with SOTA models like Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana Pro inside the timeline editor. Integrates with your agents Connects your Claude/Codex/Cursor via MCP, or use the in-app agent to work on the same project together. MCP server When the app is open, it exposes an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp via HTTP. To connect: Claude Code claude mcp add --transport http palmier-pro http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp Codex codex mcp add palmier-pro --url http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp Cursor The easiest way is go inside the app Help -> MCP Instructions -> Install in Cursor, or install manually by adding this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json: { "mcpServers": { "palmier-pro": { "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp" } } } Claude Desktop We bundle a mcpb with the app that allows a one click install Desktop Extension on Claude Desktop. Go to Help -> MCP Instructions -> Install in Claude Desktop FAQ Is Palmier Pro fully open source? The video editor (without the generative AI features) is fully open source. The MCP server and the agent chat are also open source. The only thing that is closed source is the generative AI processing. Is it free? The editor is free. You can download it with no login required, and use it as a video editor like CapCut or Adobe Premiere. You can also use the MCP server for free, and start experimenting using Claude Code/Desktop or Cursor to interact with your timeline editor. Generative AI features require login and subscription. What platforms does it support? macOS 26 (Tahoe) on Apple Silicon only. See FAQ.md for more. Development See CONTRIBUTING.md Community & Support Discord: Join the community on Discord. Twitter / X: Follow @Palmier_io for updates and announcements. Instagram: Follow @palmier.io Feedback & Support: Create a Github Issue or email us at founders@palmier.io Star History License Copyright (C) 2026 Palmier, Inc. Palmier Pro is open source under GPLv3.
tldr: Palmier Pro 开源 Mac 视频编辑器，支持 MCP 协议与 AI 代理协同编辑时间线
objective_summary: Palmier, Inc. 发布了 Palmier Pro，一款基于 Swift 构建的开源 Mac 视频编辑器，遵循 GPLv3 协议。编辑器本体、MCP 服务器和代理聊天功能开源，生成式 AI 功能需订阅。支持通过 MCP 协议连接 Claude/Codex/Cursor 等 AI
key_logic_flow: Palmier Pro 是一款基于 Swift 构建的开源 Mac 视频编辑器，遵循 GPLv3 协议。
编辑器本体、MCP 服务器和代理聊天功能完全开源，生成式 AI 功能需登录订阅使用。
支持在时间线编辑器中直接使用 Seedance、Kling、Nano Banana Pro 等模型生成视频和图像。
可通过 MCP 协议连接 Claude、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 代理，实现人机协同编辑。
应用启动后在本地 127.0.0.1:19789/mcp 暴露 MCP 服务器，支持 HTTP 传输。
目前仅支持 macOS 26 (Tahoe) 的 Apple Silicon 设备。

impact_score.reason: 评分依据：Palmier Pro 的核心价值在于将 MCP 协议深度嵌入桌面视频编辑器，使得 Claude/Codex/Cursor 等 AI 代理可以直接读写时间线，这是一种新的 AI-创意工具协作架构范式。对于 MCP 生态而言，这是目前最完整的『桌面应用 + MCP Server』一体化实现，具有标杆意义。然而其行业冲击力受到三重限制：① 仅支持 macOS 26 (Tahoe) + Apple Silicon，覆盖用户群极小；② 新产品 v1 尚无社区验证和规模化证据；③ 对标 Premiere Pro 但功能成熟度差距巨大。因此短期影响力属于『重要垂类产品发布，改变局部竞争格局』的级别，不足以影响整个视频编辑或 AI 行业格局。评分：6.0

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: MCP 协议与视频编辑器的深度集成为 AI 代理开辟了全新的创意工具操控范式

hype_assessment.reason: 判定依据：文章整体表述较为务实，提供了具体的 MCP 连接方式、开源协议、平台限制等干货信息。但存在一定包装成分：① 'The north star is Premiere Pro' 暗示了对标行业旗舰的野心，但实际产品成熟度差距悬殊；② 'Generate videos and images with SOTA models' 中的 SOTA 是常见的 PR 套话，Nano Banana Pro 等模型的实际效果缺乏第三方验证；③ 强调开源的同时，生成式 AI 功能是闭源付费的，存在『开源外壳 + 闭源内核』的灰色地带。综合判定为中度包装。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 将 MCP 服务器直接嵌入桌面视频编辑器进程，在本地 127.0.0.1:19789 暴露 HTTP 传输端点，使 AI 代理能通过标准 MCP 协议对时间线进行读写操作。这解决了长期以来 AI 工具与创作软件之间的『协议鸿沟』——不再需要截图 OCR 或 GUI 自动化，而是通过结构化协议实现 AI 与原生 UI 的协同编辑。架构本身具有可复制性：任何桌面创作工具均可借鉴此模式嵌入 MCP Server。
domain_disruption.business_model: 开源（GPLv3）编辑器核心 + 闭源付费生成式 AI 功能的双层模式，反映了 MCP 时代创意工具的商业化新路径：编辑器本身作为 AI 代理的『前端』免费获客，AI 算力和模型服务作为持续收入的收费层。这种模式可能重塑视频编辑 SaaS 的定价结构，从『买断/订阅编辑器』转向『免费工具 + 按量 AI 计费』。

compound_value.reason: Palmier Pro 的 MCP 原生架构是视频编辑领域的新范式——编辑器以 MCP 服务器暴露自身，AI 代理可直接操纵时间线，实现从'人用工具'到'人与 AI 共同使用工具'的跃迁。开源策略（GPLv3）降低采用门槛，社区贡献有望加速功能迭代，形成'工具→生态→标准'的飞轮。但风险同样显著：仅支持 macOS 26 Apple Silicon，平台锁死导致早期规模天花板极低；视频编辑领域有 Premiere Pro、DaVinci Resolve、CapCut 等成熟产品，用户迁移成本极高；GPLv3 协议限制了企业级商业集成。关键验证点在于：MCP 能否从编码工具渗透到创意工具成为跨领域标准协议；Palmier 能否在开源社区贡献与 AI 功能订阅之间建立可持续的商业模式。若 MCP 在 2-3 年内成为创意工具的'HTTP 协议'，Palmier Pro 作为先行者将占据结构性优势；否则只是又一个开源编辑器。当前评分对应'潜力型细分赛道基础设施，需持续观察生态演化'。

market_opportunities: 开发者可借鉴 Palmier Pro 的 MCP 协议集成模式，为其他创意工具（如音频工作站、3D 建模、平面设计软件）构建类似的 AI 代理协同接口，开辟创意工具的 AI 原生改造赛道
独立开发者可基于 GPLv3 开源代码，针对特定垂直场景（如短视频批量剪辑、教育视频自动生成）定制轻量级 AI 视频编辑器，降低进入视频编辑 SaaS 市场的门槛
围绕 MCP 协议生态提供咨询和工具链服务——帮助传统视频编辑软件接入 MCP 服务器，实现与 Claude/Cursor 等 AI 代理的互联互通

risk_matrix.regulatory: GPLv3 合规风险：开源部分与闭源 AI 功能的边界需要清晰界定，避免违反开源协议引发法律纠纷；AI 生成视频内容（使用 Seedance、Kling 等模型）可能触发版权诉讼和深度伪造监管审查
risk_matrix.technological: 仅支持 macOS 26 (Tahoe) 且限定 Apple Silicon，操作系统版本极新，用户覆盖范围极窄，短期内难以形成规模效应；基于 Swift 构建导致跨平台移植成本高；生成式 AI 功能依赖第三方模型 API，模型服务可用性和延迟直接影响用户体验
risk_matrix.competitive: 面临 CapCut（免费）、DaVinci Resolve（免费+专业）、Adobe Premiere Pro（行业标准）等成熟产品的竞争；大厂若快速跟进 MCP 集成方案，Palmier Pro 的差异化优势将被迅速稀释
risk_matrix.ethical: 开放的视频编辑能力结合生成式 AI 模型，可能被滥用制作深度伪造内容和虚假信息；开源协议下修改版本的分发可能脱离原始伦理约束，增加内容溯源和问责难度

title: withastro/flue
description: The sandbox agent framework.Flue — The Agent Harness Framework Not another SDK. Build autonomous agents and powerful AI workflows with Flue's programmable TypeScript harness. // agents/triage.ts import { createAgent, type AgentRouteHandler } from '@flue/runtime'; import { local } from '@flue/runtime/node'; import triage from '../skills/triage/SKILL.md' with { type: 'skill' }; import verify from '../skills/verify/SKILL.md' with { type: 'skill' }; import * as githubTools from '../tools/github.ts'; // Give agents the context and autonomy to solve complex tasks: const instructions = ` Triage a bug report end-to-end: reproduce the bug, diagnose the root cause, verify whether the behavior is intentional, and attempt a fix. ...`; // Expose (and protect) your agents over HTTP: export const route: AgentRouteHandler = async (_c, next) => next(); // Compose the complete harness your agent needs to do real work, // complete with virtual, local, or remote container sandbox. export default createAgent(() => ({ model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6', tools: [...githubTools], skills: [triage, verify], sandbox: local(), instructions, })); The framework for building the next generation of agents. The first agents were built with raw LLM API calls. This worked for simple chatbots and scripted tasks, but not much else. Agents like Claude Code and Codex broke the mold. These were real agents. Autonomous. You give them a task — not a pre-defined series of steps — and trust them to complete it using the context and tools that you provide. Flue unlocks this new architecture for agents. Its built-in TypeScript harness gives any model the context and environment it needs for truly autonomous work: sessions, tools, skills, instructions, filesystem access, and a secure sandbox to run in. Run your agents locally via CLI or deploy them to your hosted runtime of choice. Features Build agents that can safely take action, maintain continuity, and connect to the systems where work already happens. Agents — Build agents that can keep context across conversations and events as they autonomously work toward a goal. Workflows — Run structured automations where your code guides agent reasoning from a clear input to a finished result. Sandboxes — Give agents a secure environment where they can use tools, modify files, and autonomously complete real work. Durable Execution — Learn how agents preserve progress through failures and restarts with durable recovery for accepted work. Subagents — Define specialized roles for different tasks, then let your agent delegate work to the right expert. Tools — Give agents typed actions for calling APIs, querying data, and making controlled changes through your application. Skills — Package reusable expertise and workflows that agents can load whenever a task needs specialized guidance. MCP Servers — Connect agents to authenticated tools and services through the open Model Context Protocol ecosystem. Observability — Monitor your agents and export telemetry with OpenTelemetry, Braintrust, Sentry, or your own observer. Channels — Receive verified events from Slack, Teams, Discord, GitHub, and more. tldr: Astro 发布 Flue，一个可编程 TypeScript 运行时框架，用于构建自主 AI Agent 和工作流。
objective_summary: Astro (withastro) 发布了 Flue 开源项目，这是一个 TypeScript 可编程运行时框架，用于构建自主 AI Agent 和工作流。Flue 提供会话管理、工具调用、技能加载、沙箱安全执行和持久化执行等能力，支持本地 CLI 运行或远程部署，并集成 MCP 协议和
key_logic_flow: Flue 是 Astro 发布的 TypeScript 开源框架，旨在用于构建自主 AI Agent 和可编程工作流，而不是传统的 SDK 模式。
Flue 的核心设计理念是让开发者构建可自主行动的 Agent——只需给出任务目标而非预定义步骤，Agent 利用上下文和工具自主完成任务。
Flue 提供完整的运行时能力：会话管理、工具调用、技能加载、文件系统访问、沙箱安全执行环境和持久化执行恢复。
Flue 支持通过 HTTP 路由暴露 Agent，支持本地 CLI 运行或部署到远程托管运行时，并内置子 Agent 委派机制。
Flue 的生态集成包括 MCP Server、OpenTelemetry 可观测性适配、Postgres 持久化适配，以及 Slack、Teams、Discord、GitHub 等渠道的事件接收。
Flue 提供四个核心包：@flue/runtime（运行时核心）、@flue/cli（CLI 工具）、@flue/sdk（客户端 SDK）和 @flue/opentelemetry（可观测性适配器）。

impact_score.reason: Astro 团队凭借前端框架领域的极高声誉和开发者信任度进入 AI Agent 框架赛道，其 'Not another SDK' 的定位和可编程 TypeScript Harness 架构具有明确的差异化策略。技能模块导入(import with { type: 'skill' })和内置沙箱等设计显示出对开发者体验的深度思考。然而，当前 AI Agent 框架市场已高度拥挤——LangChain、CrewAI、Vercel AI SDK、AutoGPT 等均已建立各自的生态位。Flue 作为新入场者尚未证明其生态吸引力和规模化能力，短期行业关注度会显著提升但不足以引发范式转移。评分基于：中等冲击力（重要产品发布 + 品牌信誉加持），但赛道拥挤限制了上层空间。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: Flue 的'可编程 Harness'架构与 LangChain/Vercel AI SDK 等现有方案的实际开发体验差异及自主 Agent 能力上限

hype_assessment.reason: 项目 README 以具体技术描述为主，未使用'颠覆'、'革命性'、'重塑'等 PR 滥用词汇。'Not another SDK' 是明确的定位陈述而非空洞口号。代码示例、架构设计（4 个核心包）、功能清单（会话管理、工具调用、沙箱安全执行、持久化恢复、MCP 集成、OpenTelemetry 可观测性）均为可验证的技术能力，无概念包装痕迹。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 提出 TypeScript 可编程 Harness 架构替代传统 SDK 模式，以 'createAgent() + 技能模块导入(import ... with { type: "skill" }) + 沙箱安全执行' 三元组原语替代主流 Agent 框架的链式编排/图工作流范式。技能以 Markdown 文件作为一等模块导入的设计，本质是将 Prompt Engineering 提升为类型安全的语言级抽象，具有工程实践上的创新性。
domain_disruption.business_model: Astro 将其前端框架的生态建设经验（开源+插件系统+集成市场）延伸至 AI Agent 领域。若 Flue 走相似路径，可能催生围绕 Agent 技能(Skills)、工具(Tools)和 MCP Server 集成的开发者市场生态，进而影响 AI 工作流工具链的商业格局——从单一的 API 调用收费转向组件市场和托管运行时服务。

compound_value.reason: Flue 定位为 TypeScript 原生的自主 Agent 运行时框架，而非传统 SDK，这一设计理念切中了当前 Agent 开发的核心痛点：开发者需要的是能自主决策的运行时环境（会话管理、沙箱安全、持久化执行），而非单纯的大模型 API 封装。Astro 团队在开发者工具领域拥有良好品牌信誉和社区信任（Astro 框架已验证其交付能力），这是早期项目最稀缺的资产。Flue 的开源策略 + MCP 协议原生集成 + TypeScript 生态切入，有望在 Web 开发者群体中快速形成采用。但该赛道极其拥挤：LangChain 已建立 Python 生态护城河，Vercel AI SDK 依托 Vercel 云平台优势，CrewAI 在多 Agent 协作领域先发。Flue 的长期复利取决于两个关键变量：(1)能否在 6-12 个月内形成显著的开发者社区和技能/工具生态；(2)Astro 团队是否有足够资本支持持续投入，避免被大厂同质化竞争碾压。目前处于早期破局阶段，潜力与风险并存，建议密切关注开发者 adoption 速度。

market_opportunities: 开发者可基于 Flue 构建垂直行业的自主 Agent，如自动化代码审查、DevOps 故障排查、安全事件响应等场景，利用其沙箱安全执行和工具调用能力替代人工操作
Flue 的 Skill 包机制和 MCP 集成开辟了 Agent 技能/工具市场机会，开发者可封装领域专业知识为可复用技能包，形成生态变现渠道
企业级工作流自动化场景（如 CI/CD 流水线、客户支持工单处理）可借助 Flue 的持久化执行和子 Agent 委派能力，构建高可靠性的 AI 自动化管线

risk_matrix.regulatory: 自主 Agent 的决策行为可能引发合规责任归属问题，尤其是金融、医疗等强监管行业——当 Agent 自主执行操作造成损失时，责任界定尚不清晰。需关注各司法管辖区对 AI Agent 行为的监管动态
risk_matrix.technological: Agent 框架赛道已十分拥挤：Vercel AI SDK、LangChain/LangGraph、CrewAI 等竞品已建立先发优势。Flue 作为新入场者，面临生态成熟度不足和开发者认知门槛的双重挑战
risk_matrix.competitive: Astro 的核心品牌认知在 Web 框架而非 AI Agent 领域，可能面临开发者信任度不足的问题。Vercel 等竞争对手已拥有深厚的 AI 工具链和开发者社区，Flue 需要在差异化定位上持续发力
risk_matrix.ethical: 自主 Agent 获取工具调用和文件系统访问权限后，若指令不够精确或安全边界配置不当，可能导致非预期的破坏性操作。沙箱逃逸风险和数据隐私泄露是需要重点防范的伦理隐患

Name ★ msitarzewski/agency-agents 115k 271 VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents 22k 156 💡 TIPS AND TRICKS (83) 🚫👶 = do not babysit Prompting · Planning · Context · Session · CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules · Agents · Commands · Skills · Hooks · Workflows · Advanced · Git / PR · Debugging · Utilities · Daily ■ Prompting (3) Tip Source challenge Claude — "grill me on these changes and don't make a PR until I pass your test." or "prove to me this works" and have Claude diff between main and your branch 🚫👶 after a mediocre fix — "knowing everything you know now, scrap this and implement the elegant solution" 🚫👶 Claude fixes most bugs by itself — paste the bug, say "fix", don't micromanage how 🚫👶 ■ Planning/Specs (7) Tip Source always start with plan mode start with a minimal spec or prompt and ask Claude to interview you using AskUserQuestion tool, then make a new session to execute the spec always make a phase-wise gated plan, with each phase having multiple tests (unit, automation, integration) break PRDs into vertical slices (tracer bullets) that cross all layers (DB + service + UI) — AI defaults to horizontal phasing (DB phase, then API phase, then frontend phase) which delays end-to-end feedback until the last phase. From the Pragmatic Programmer 🚫👶 spin up a second Claude to review your plan as a staff engineer, or use cross-model for review write detailed specs and reduce ambiguity before handing work off — the more specific you are, the better the output prototype > PRD — build 20-30 versions instead of writing specs, the cost of building is low so take many shots ■ Context (5) Tip Source context rot kicks in around ~300-400k tokens on the 1M context model — don't let sessions drift past that for intelligence-sensitive work dumb zone kicks in around ~40% context — "you hit this point where you have degrading results". Newcomers: "shoot to keep it under 40%, and if you get up to 60%, think about wrapping it up". Experienced: "aggressively keep it below 30%" — push to 60% only on simple tasks. Manual /compact or /clear to reset when switching tasks rewind > correct — double-Esc or /rewind back to before the failed attempt and re-prompt with what you learned, instead of leaving failed attempts + corrections polluting context 🚫👶 /compact with a hint (/compact focus on the auth refactor, drop the test debugging) beats letting autocompact fire — the model is at its least intelligent point when auto-compacting due to context rot use subagents for context management — ask yourself "will I need this tool output again, or just the conclusion?" — 20 file reads + 12 greps + 3 dead ends stay in the child's context, only the final report returns 🚫👶 ■ Session Management (6) Tip Source every turn is a branching point — after Claude ends a turn, pick between Continue, /rewind, /clear, /compact, or Subagent based on how much existing context you need to carry forward new task = new session — related tasks (e.g. writing docs for what you just built) can reuse context for efficiency, but genuinely new tasks deserve a fresh session use "summarize from here" before rewinding to have Claude write a handoff message — like a note to the previous iteration of Claude from its future self /compact vs /clear — compact is lossy but momentum-friendly (mid-task, fuzzy details ok); /clear + brief is more work but you control exactly what carries forward (high-stakes next step) use recaps for long-running sessions — short summaries of what Claude did and what's next, useful when returning after minutes or hours. Disable with recaps in /config /rename important sessions (e.g. [TODO - refactor task]) and /resume them later — label each instance when running multiple Claudes simultaneously ■ CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules (8) Tip Source CLAUDE.md should target under 200 lines per file. 60 lines in humanlayer (still not 100% guaranteed) .claude/rules/*.md auto-load into every session like CLAUDE.md — add paths: YAML frontmatter to lazy-load them only when Claude touches files matching the glob wrap domain-specific CLAUDE.md rules in <important if="..."> tags to stop Claude from ignoring them as files grow longer use multiple CLAUDE.md for monorepos — ancestor + descendant loading use .claude/rules/ to split large instructions any developer should be able to launch Claude, say "run the tests" and it works on the first try — if it doesn't, your CLAUDE.md is missing essential setup/build/test commands keep codebases clean and finish migrations — partially migrated frameworks confuse models that might pick the wrong pattern use settings.json for harness-enforced behavior (attribution, permissions, model) — don't put "NEVER add Co-Authored-By" in CLAUDE.md when attribution.commit: "" is deterministic Agents (4) Tip Source have feature specific sub-agents (extra context) with skills (progressive disclosure) instead of general qa, backend engineer say "use subagents" to throw more compute at a problem — offload tasks to keep your main context clean and focused 🚫👶 agent teams with tmux and git worktrees for parallel development use test time compute — separate context windows make results better; one agent can cause bugs and another (same model) can find them Commands (3) Tip Source use commands for your workflows instead of sub-agents use slash commands for every "inner loop" workflow you do many times a day — saves repeated prompting, commands live in .claude/commands/ and are checked into git if you do something more than once a day, turn it into a skill or command — build /techdebt, context-dump, or analytics commands Skills (9) Tip Source use context: fork to run a skill in an isolated subagent — main context only sees the final result, not intermediate tool calls. The agent field lets you set the subagent type use skills in subfolders for monorepos skills are folders, not files — use references/, scripts/, examples/ subdirectories for progressive disclosure build a Gotchas section in every skill — highest-signal content, add Claude's failure points over time skill description field is a trigger, not a summary — write it for the model ("when should I fire?") don't state the obvious in skills — focus on what pushes Claude out of its default behavior 🚫👶 don't railroad Claude in skills — give goals and constraints, not prescriptive step-by-step instructions 🚫👶 include scripts and libraries in skills so Claude composes rather than reconstructs boilerplate embed !command in SKILL.md to inject dynamic shell output into the prompt — Claude runs it on invocation and the model only sees the result ■ Hooks (5) Tip Source use on-demand hooks in skills — /careful blocks destructive commands, /freeze blocks edits outside a directory measure skill usage with a PreToolUse hook to find popular or undertriggering skills use a PostToolUse hook to auto-format code — Claude generates well-formatted code, the hook handles the last 10% to avoid CI failures route permission requests to Opus via a hook — let it scan for attacks and auto-approve safe ones 🚫👶 use a Stop hook to nudge Claude to keep going or verify its work at the end of a turn ■ Workflows (5) Tip Source use /model to select model and reasoning, /context to see context usage, /usage to check plan limits, /extra-usage to configure overflow billing, /config to configure settings — use Opus for plan mode and Sonnet for code to get the best of both always use thinking mode true (to see reasoning) and Output Style Explanatory (to see detailed output with ★ Insight boxes) in /config for better understanding of Claude's decisions use ultrathink keyword in prompts for high effort reasoning /focus mode hides all intermediate work and shows only the final result — trust the model to run the right commands and just look at the outcome (toggle with /focus) tune effort level with Opus 4.7's adaptive thinking — low for speed and fewer tokens, max for most intelligence (slider: low · medium · high · xhigh · max) ■ Workflows Advanced (9) Tip Source use ASCII diagrams a lot to understand your architecture use /loop for local recurring monitoring (up to 7 days) · use /schedule for cloud-based recurring tasks that run even when your machine is off use Ralph Wiggum plugin for long-running autonomous tasks /permissions with wildcard syntax (Bash(npm run *), Edit(/docs/**)) instead of dangerously-skip-permissions /sandbox to reduce permission prompts with file and network isolation — 84% reduction internally invest in product verification skills (signup-flow-driver, checkout-verifier) — worth spending a week to perfect use auto mode instead of dangerously-skip-permissions — a model-based classifier decides if each command is safe and auto-approves, pauses and asks if risky. Shift+Tab to cycle Ask → Plan → Auto modes 🚫👶 use /less-permission-prompts skill to scan session history for safe bash/MCP commands that repeatedly prompt, then get a recommended allowlist to paste into settings build a /go skill that (1) tests end-to-end via bash/browser/computer use (2) runs /simplify (3) puts up a PR — so when you come back, you know the code works 🚫👶 ■ Git / PR (5) Tip Source keep PRs small and focused — p50 of 118 lines (141 PRs, 45K lines changed in a day), one feature per PR, easier to review and revert always squash merge PRs — clean linear history, one commit per feature, easy git revert and git bisect commit often — try to commit at least once per hour, as soon as task is completed, commit tag @claude on a coworker's PR to auto-generate lint rules for recurring review feedback — automate yourself out of code review 🚫👶 use /code-review for multi-agent PR analysis — catches bugs, security vulnerabilities, and regressions before merge ■ Debugging (6) Tip Source make it a habit to take screenshots and share with Claude whenever you are stuck with any issue use mcp (Claude in Chrome, Playwright, Chrome DevTools) to let claude see chrome console logs on its own always ask claude to run the terminal (you want to see logs of) as a background task for better debugging /doctor to diagnose installation, authentication, and configuration issues use a cross-model for QA — e.g. Codex for plan and implementation review agentic search (glob + grep) beats RAG — Claude Code tried and discarded vector databases because code drifts out of sync and permissions are complex ■ Utilities (5) Tip Source iTerm/Ghostty/tmux terminals instead of IDE (VS Code/Cursor) /voice or Wispr Flow for voice prompting (10x productivity) claude-code-hooks for claude feedback status line for context awareness and fast compacting explore settings.json features like Plans Directory, Spinner Verbs for a personalized experience ■ Daily (2) Tip Source update Claude objective_summary: 该仓库系统整理了 Claude Code 的所有核心功能模块（Subagents、Commands、Skills、Workflows、Hooks、MCP 等）、配置项、跨模型集成方案以及来自多名专家（Boris Cherny 等）的实用技巧，是一份面向开发者的 Claude Code 操作指南。
key_logic_flow: Claude Code 的扩展体系包含 Subagents、Commands、Skills、Workflows、Hooks、MCP Servers 六大核心机制，分别对应 .claude/ 目录下的不同子目录。
所有主要工作流都遵循 Research → Plan → Execute → Review → Ship 的五步架构模式。
跨模型协作可通过 Plugin（插件）、MCP（协议调用）和 Router（API 路由切换）三种机制实现，支持与 Codex、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek 等模型协同。
上下文管理有明确阈值：300-400k tokens 进入上下文衰退区，40% 上下文使用率是推荐的警戒线，60% 时应考虑结束当前会话。
CLAUDE.md 应控制在 200 行以内，可通过 .claude/rules/*.md 按 glob 匹配懒加载，并支持 monorepo 的祖先+后代级联加载。
建议将高频重复操作抽象为 Command（存入 .claude/commands/）或 Skill（存入 .claude/skills/），以节省重复提示的开销。
